episodes.name: Radom
episodes.plot: The Kurc family celebrates Passover in Radom, Poland. One year later, the onset of World War II forces a devastating separation.

episodes.name: Lvov
episodes.plot: Halina and Bella start their passage to Lvov. Sol, Nechuma, and Mila must find a new home in German-occupied Radom. Addy is conscripted into a Polish unit of the French army.

translations.value: Halina and Bella start their passage to Lvov. Sol, Nechuma, and Mila must find a new home in German-occupied Radom. Addy is conscripted into a Polish unit of the French army.

episodes.name: Siberia
episodes.plot: Genek and Herta are sent on a grueling train ride. Addy escapes Europe by sea. Halina starts a new job in Soviet-Occupied Lvov.

translations.value: Genek and Herta are sent on a grueling train ride. Addy escapes Europe by sea. Halina starts a new job in Soviet-Occupied Lvov.

episodes.name: Casablanca
episodes.plot: Mila does everything to protect young Felicia. Halina, Jakob, and Bella face new danger in Lvov. Addy searches for Eliska in Morocco.

episodes.name: Ilha Das Flores
episodes.plot: Halina, Jakob, and Bella search for those missing in Lvov. Addy and Eliska attempt to enter Brazil. Genek faces a Siberian winter and a question of faith. Sol and Nechuma observe Rosh Hashanah.

episodes.name: Warsaw
episodes.plot: With Sol and Nechuma in danger, Halina attempts to find refuge for her parents; Mila learns to assimilate in Warsaw; Bella searches for solace at the AVL Factory; Jakob faces life alone in the Radom ghetto.

episodes.name: Monte Cassino
episodes.plot: Halina and Adam prepare for impending violence in Warsaw; Genek embarks on a dangerous mission; Addy struggles to move on with the unknown fate of his family.

episodes.plot: Halina's strength and hope are put to the test; Addy builds a new life in Rio; the end of the war triggers the Kurc family's final search for answers.

overview.value: We Were the Lucky Ones è una serie statunitense basata sul romanzo di Georgia Hunter "Noi, i salvati", ispirato all'incredibile storia vera della sua famiglia ebrea, che, separata all'inizio della Seconda guerra mondiale, ha cercato con determinazione di sopravvivere e riunirsi.

tagline.value: Inspired by one family's true story of survival.

translations.overview: We Were the Lucky Ones è una serie statunitense basata sul romanzo di Georgia Hunter "Noi, i salvati", ispirato all'incredibile storia vera della sua famiglia ebrea, che, separata all'inizio della Seconda guerra mondiale, ha cercato con determinazione di sopravvivere e riunirsi.
The true story of one Jewish family separated at the start of World War II, determined to survive—and to reunite.
translations.tagline: Inspired by one family's true story of survival.
